title: Finite duality and dualizing-object inclusions respect scalar extension
statement:
theorem finite_dual_inclusion_coherent (B : Duality D l hl Ω X) :
    (∀ (K : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω X)
    {E L : Index l Ω} (hi : K.stage ≤ E) (h : E ≤ L),
    (inclusion L).map
        (((operationStageTransitionIso l Ω X E L h).hom.app
            ((B.finite.datum E).dual.obj (op (K.toStage hi))) ≫
          (B.finite.beta E L h).hom.app (op (K.toStage hi)) ≫
          (B.finite.datum L).dual.map
            ((operationStageTransitionIso l Ω X E L h).hom.app (K.toStage hi)).op) ≫
          (B.finite.datum L).dual.map
            (((stageSystem l Ω X).assoc hi h).inv.app K.obj).op) ≫
        (B.comparison L).hom.app (op (K.toStage (hi.trans h))) ≫
        B.duality.dual.map (((stageSystem l Ω X).isoToStage K (hi.trans h)).hom).op =
      ((stageSystem l Ω X).transIso h).hom.app
          ((B.finite.datum E).dual.obj (op (K.toStage hi))) ≫
        (B.comparison E).hom.app (op (K.toStage hi)) ≫
        B.duality.dual.map (((stageSystem l Ω X).isoToStage K hi).hom).op) ∧
    (∀ {E L : Index l Ω} (h : E ≤ L),
    (inclusion L).map ((operationStageTransitionIso l Ω X E L h).hom.app
          ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) X).obj
            (B.finite.omega E).omega) ≫ (B.finite.scalar E L h).omega.hom) ≫
        (B.omegaComparison L).hom =
      ((stageSystem l Ω X).transIso h).hom.app
          ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) X).obj
            (B.finite.omega E).omega) ≫ (B.omegaComparison E).hom)

source.place: Coefficient transport through thm-coef-qbar-verdier; explicit normalization step of lem-coef-qbar-verdier-internal-hom-universal

proof.text: Normalize the inclusion-transition isomorphism as the scalar-functor equality whiskered with inclusion, followed by the stage transIso. Equality induction transports the two recorded finite inclusion squares to the stage-system transition.

For an arbitrary representative of K at E, naturality of its finite dual comparison moves the associator into the global dual functor. Composition of the isoToStage maps identifies the resulting morphism with the representative at the larger stage. The dualizing-object clause is the transported recorded square.
